extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers studying North Carolina Civil War and Reconstruction history
extracted.subtask_description: End-of-chapter study questions and narrative passages from a textbook-style history of North Carolina covering 1864–1868; intended to test comprehension of events, people, dates, and consequences during the closing years of the Civil War and early Reconstruction.
